header.note: Every layer is given twice: *_xy = local TM metres about P0 (origin.json; x east, y north; ints x scale) and *_ll = [lon, lat] ints x ll_scale degrees. Rings flat, no closing vertex, exterior CCW, holes CW. Sea = absence of land. TM scale distortion at the box edge (300 km) is 0.11 %, i.e. xy is a projection, not true ground distance; use *_ll for a globe.
source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL): natural=coastline, polygonised inside the box (land on the left of the way)
Natural Earth 10m (public domain): lakes, lakes_north_america, rivers_lake_centerlines, rivers_north_america, admin_1_states_provinces_lines

schema.lakes_xy / lakes_ll: NE 10m lakes inside land (simplified 25 m; NE accuracy ~ 100s of m)
schema.rivers: [name_index, scalerank, line_xy, line_ll] NE 10m centrelines (only where on land)
